cds.title: Miami University (Oxford) Common Data Set 2024-2025 (xlsx; the 2025-2026 edition is not posted on the CDS page)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-25 (fall 2024 entering class; the 2025-26 CDS was not posted). Test-optional: 8.2% of enrolled first-year students submitted SAT scores (342) and 23.9% ACT (1,000). The ED figure covers binding Early Decision (521 applied, 438 admitted); Miami also has non-binding Early Action. Average GPA 3.82 is for 100% of enrolled students and uses weighted/recalculated GPAs.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1 for 2025-26, rounded to the dollar): in-state tuition $17,191, non-resident tuition $40,713, required fees $1,328, on-campus housing $10,594 plus meal plan $6,560 (food and housing $17,154). Estimated expenses: books $1,290, transportation $1,340, other $2,600 (other shown = transportation + other). Miami's cost-of-attendance page gives 2026-27 estimates: tuition and fees $18,890 (Ohio/reciprocal residents) or $42,882 (non-Ohio residents), housing and food $17,668 (weighted average), total $60,550 for non-Ohio residents. Per the CDS (H6, 2024-25 estimated), 304 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional non-need-based aid, average $16,115. Miami Tuition Promise fixes tuition for four years.
